sloka: को न्व् अनेन अप्रतीतेन स उत्कण्ठित जनेन च ।सम्प्रीयेत अमनोज्ञेन वासेन हृत चेतसा ॥२-४८-२०॥
transliteration: ko nv anena apratītena sa utkaṇṭhita janena ca ।samprīyeta amanojñena vāsena hṛta cetasā ॥2-48-20॥

translations.english: The people here are choked with grief. Who will like to stay here where life is disagreeable, cheerless, full of despondency and distress?
